model_manager_queue_enabled.label: Show the Queue Tab and its button beside Generate
model_manager_queue_enabled.info: When on, a Queue button appears beside Generate in txt2img and img2img. It saves the generation as a task instead of running it, and the Queue tab runs the saved tasks. When off, the tab and the buttons disappear at once and a running queue stops; from the next start of the WebUI they are not created at all. Your saved tasks are kept, and come back when you turn this on again.
model_manager_queue_enabled.name: Queue Tab
model_manager_queue_enabled.heading: Queue Tab

model_manager_record_generations.label: Record your generations and show the Generations Tab
model_manager_record_generations.info: When on, every txt2img and img2img image saved to disk is recorded with all the settings that made it. Recorded images show in the Generations tab, and in the gallery of each model they used. When off, nothing new is recorded, and the Generations tab and each model's Your generations disappear at once; from the next start of the WebUI the Generations tab is not created at all. What was recorded is kept, and comes back when you turn this on again.
model_manager_record_generations.name: Generations Tab
model_manager_record_generations.heading: Generations Tab

model_manager_gallery_tab.label: Show the Civitai Images Tab
model_manager_gallery_tab.info: When on, the Civitai Images tab shows the Civitai images stored for the models in your library, in an order set by its seed. When off, the tab disappears at once and stops, and from the next start of the WebUI it is not created at all.
model_manager_gallery_tab.name: Civitai Images Tab
model_manager_gallery_tab.heading: Civitai Images Tab

model_manager_model_manager_enabled.label: Show the Model Manager Tab
model_manager_model_manager_enabled.info: When on, the Model Manager tab shows your models with their details and galleries, and syncs them with Civitai. When off, the tab disappears at once and stops, and from the next start of the WebUI it is not created at all. A sync that is already running finishes. Your library is kept, and downloads still add to it.
model_manager_model_manager_enabled.name: Model Manager Tab
model_manager_model_manager_enabled.heading: Model Manager Tab

model_manager_civitai_browser_enabled.label: Show the Civitai Browser Tab
model_manager_civitai_browser_enabled.info: When on, the Civitai Browser tab lets you search Civitai and download from it. When off, the tab disappears at once and stops, and from the next start of the WebUI it is not created at all. Downloads that are already running finish.
model_manager_civitai_browser_enabled.name: Civitai Browser Tab
model_manager_civitai_browser_enabled.heading: Civitai Browser Tab

model_manager_civitai_api_key.label: Civitai API key
model_manager_civitai_api_key.info: Optional. With your Civitai API key, Civitai allows more requests to its API before it starts turning them away.
model_manager_civitai_api_key.name: Civitai API key
model_manager_civitai_api_key.heading: Shared across tabs

model_manager_civitai_requests_per_secon.label: Requests to Civitai per second
model_manager_civitai_requests_per_secon.info: How many requests per second the extension sends to Civitai's API while an API key is set. A higher number is faster, but makes it more likely that Civitai turns requests away. A change applies to the next search, download or sync; one already running keeps its speed.
model_manager_civitai_requests_per_secon.name: Requests per second
model_manager_civitai_requests_per_secon.heading: Shared across tabs

model_manager_civitai_images_at_once.label: How many gallery images load in parallel
model_manager_civitai_images_at_once.info: When a model's gallery or the Civitai Images tab shows Civitai's images, your browser fetches each picture or video from Civitai's image server. This sets how many it fetches at the same time. The others wait their turn, and those nearest the screen go first. Civitai makes its resized copies at about 10 to 16 a second and queues the rest; when hundreds were asked for at once, many failed to load. It does not change how many images a page holds: each tab has its own setting for that.
model_manager_civitai_images_at_once.name: How many gallery images load in parallel
model_manager_civitai_images_at_once.heading: Shared across tabs

model_manager_downloads_at_once.label: How many downloads in parallel
model_manager_downloads_at_once.info: How many downloads run at the same time. The others wait their turn in the queue. A fast connection may want more; a hard disk, a network drive or a slow connection may want 1. Start now still starts a waiting download, even above this number. A change applies at once: a lower number lets the running downloads finish, and starts no new one until fewer are running.
model_manager_downloads_at_once.name: How many downloads in parallel
model_manager_downloads_at_once.heading: Shared across tabs

model_manager_download_in_parts.label: Download large files in parts
model_manager_download_in_parts.info: When on, a large file is downloaded from Civitai over several connections at once, each fetching a part of it. Civitai's storage limits each connection to about 60 MB/s, so a faster line gets large files sooner. When off, every file downloads over one connection. A change applies to the next download, and to a paused one when it resumes.
model_manager_download_in_parts.name: Download large files in parts
model_manager_download_in_parts.heading: Shared across tabs

model_manager_connections_per_file.label: Connections per file, for files downloaded in parts
model_manager_connections_per_file.info: How many connections a large file is downloaded over. Each part is at least 32 MB, so a smaller file uses fewer connections. A change applies to the next download, and to a paused one when it resumes.
model_manager_connections_per_file.name: Connections per file
model_manager_connections_per_file.heading: Shared across tabs

model_manager_civitai_folder_template.label: Folder a download is filed into
model_manager_civitai_folder_template.info: Where a downloaded model is saved, inside the folder Forge uses for its type: Stable-diffusion for checkpoints, Lora for LoRAs, and so on. Write a path, and add any of these to fill in the model's details: {baseModel} for its base model, {modelName} for its name, {creator} for its creator's user name and {modelId} for its Civitai id. A model's details can contain spaces, or characters Windows does not allow in a folder name, such as : or ?. Each of those becomes an underscore: the base model SDXL 1.0 becomes the folder SDXL_1.0. The default, _{baseModel}/{modelName}, saves an SDXL LoRA named My Style in Lora/_SDXL_1.0/My_Style. Leave it empty to save every model straight into its type's folder.
model_manager_civitai_folder_template.name: Download folder
model_manager_civitai_folder_template.heading: Shared across tabs

model_manager_card_originals.label: Load model cards' images full size, not resized
model_manager_card_originals.info: When on, model cards load each picture as it was uploaded to Civitai, instead of a copy Civitai's image server resizes to the card. Uploads are much larger: on 20 images, a card-sized copy was 54 KB on average and the upload 3.6 MB, 66 times as much. Even so, a copy is often slower the first time, because Civitai seldom has it ready: in one test it had 1 copy in 34, against 15 uploads in 33, and took about half a second to make each copy. Videos always load as copies, because an upload can be a GIF that cannot play. This applies to the cards in both the Model Manager and the Civitai Browser.
model_manager_card_originals.name: Full-size images on model cards
model_manager_card_originals.heading: Shared across tabs

model_manager_card_videos_play.label: Play videos on model cards
model_manager_card_videos_play.info: When on, a model card whose cover is a video plays it. When off, the card shows a still from the video with a play button in its corner, and the video loads only when you press it. Galleries and the image viewer are not affected.
model_manager_card_videos_play.name: Play videos on model cards
model_manager_card_videos_play.heading: Shared across tabs

model_manager_combine_lora_kinds.label: Combine every kind of LoRA into one type
model_manager_combine_lora_kinds.info: When on, the Type filter lists one entry for every kind of LoRA instead of one entry for each kind, so a single pick shows them all: a LoCon or a LoKr shows there together with ordinary LoRAs. When off, each kind has its own entry, as before. Model cards and a model's details still name the exact kind. This applies to the Type filter in both the Model Manager and the Civitai Browser.
model_manager_combine_lora_kinds.name: Combine LoRA kinds
model_manager_combine_lora_kinds.heading: Shared across tabs

model_manager_gallery_originals.label: Load gallery images full size, not resized
model_manager_gallery_originals.info: When on, galleries load each image as it was uploaded to Civitai, instead of a copy Civitai's image server resizes to fit. Uploads are much larger: on 20 images, a card-sized copy was 54 KB on average and the upload 3.6 MB, 66 times as much. Even so, a copy is often slower the first time, because Civitai seldom has it ready: in one test it had 1 copy in 34, against 15 uploads in 33, and took about half a second to make each copy. Videos always load as copies, because an upload can be a GIF that cannot play. The image viewer shows the upload either way. This applies to model galleries and the Civitai Images tab.
model_manager_gallery_originals.name: Full-size images in galleries
model_manager_gallery_originals.heading: Shared across tabs

model_manager_generations_grid.label: Scrolling in long grids of the Generations Tab
model_manager_generations_grid.info: How the Generations tab handles a long grid of tiles as you scroll. Either way, tiles load 100 at a time as you near the end. Smooth, the default, keeps on the page only the tiles within about 3,000 px of what you see, and draws the others again as you scroll back to them: scrolling to the end of 75,685 images never froze for more than 50 ms. Keep every tile leaves all the tiles loaded so far on the page, so the browser's Find (Ctrl+F) can search them all, but the page gets slower the further you scroll: at the end of 75,684 images it froze for up to 42 seconds at a time.
model_manager_generations_grid.name: Scrolling in long grids
model_manager_generations_grid.heading: Generations Tab

model_manager_generations_reading.label: Read Generations Tab tiles in one pass, alpha
model_manager_generations_reading.info: How the Generations tab reads your images to build its tiles. When on, it reads them once, into a temporary table in memory, and builds every tile from it: grouped by base model, 75,684 images took 0.28 s instead of 1.47 s. When off, it reads them again for each tile's previews, checkpoint and LoRAs, as it did before. This is still being tested: if tiles look wrong or a set of tiles does not load, turn it off and report it.
model_manager_generations_reading.name: Read tiles in one pass
model_manager_generations_reading.heading: Generations Tab

model_manager_gallery_grid.label: Scrolling in long grids of the Civitai Images Tab
model_manager_gallery_grid.info: How the Civitai Images tab handles a long grid of tiles as you scroll. Either way, tiles load 100 at a time as you near the end. Smooth, the default, keeps on the page only the tiles within about 3,000 px of what you see, and draws the others again as you scroll back to them: scrolling to the end of 75,685 images never froze for more than 50 ms. Keep every tile leaves all the tiles loaded so far on the page, so the browser's Find (Ctrl+F) can search them all, but the page gets slower the further you scroll: at the end of 75,684 images it froze for up to 42 seconds at a time.
model_manager_gallery_grid.name: Scrolling in long grids
model_manager_gallery_grid.heading: Civitai Images Tab

model_manager_page_size.label: Models per page in the Model Manager Tab
model_manager_page_size.info: How many models a page of the Model Manager shows.
model_manager_page_size.name: Models per page
model_manager_page_size.heading: Model Manager Tab

model_manager_mm_images_per_page.label: Civitai images per page in a model's gallery
model_manager_mm_images_per_page.info: How many images each press of Load More adds to a model's Civitai images. The count includes the images the NSFW and prompt switches then hide.
model_manager_mm_images_per_page.name: Civitai images per page
model_manager_mm_images_per_page.heading: Model Manager Tab

model_manager_mm_generations_per_page.label: Generations per page in a model's Your generations
model_manager_mm_generations_per_page.info: How many images each press of Load More adds to a model's Your generations. The Generations tab does not use it, because it loads more as you scroll.
model_manager_mm_generations_per_page.name: Generations per page
model_manager_mm_generations_per_page.heading: Model Manager Tab

model_manager_card_size.label: Card size in the Model Manager Tab
model_manager_card_size.info: The size of the model cards, as width x height in pixels.
model_manager_card_size.name: Card size
model_manager_card_size.heading: Model Manager Tab

model_manager_preview_least_nsfw.label: Use a model's least explicit image as its card's cover
model_manager_preview_least_nsfw.info: When on, each model card shows the model's least explicit image as its cover. When off, it shows the most recent one. Whether galleries hide explicit images is a separate setting, Hide explicit images by default.
model_manager_preview_least_nsfw.name: Least explicit image as cover
model_manager_preview_least_nsfw.heading: Model Manager Tab

model_manager_civitai_page_size.label: Models per page in the Civitai Browser Tab
model_manager_civitai_page_size.info: How many models a page of the Civitai Browser shows.
model_manager_civitai_page_size.name: Models per page
model_manager_civitai_page_size.heading: Civitai Browser Tab

model_manager_cb_images_per_page.label: Images per page in the Civitai Browser Tab
model_manager_cb_images_per_page.info: How many images each press of Load More adds to a model's images in the Civitai Browser, fetched from Civitai. The count includes the images the NSFW and prompt switches then hide.
model_manager_cb_images_per_page.name: Images per page
model_manager_cb_images_per_page.heading: Civitai Browser Tab

model_manager_civitai_card_size.label: Card size in the Civitai Browser Tab
model_manager_civitai_card_size.info: The size of the model cards, as width x height in pixels.
model_manager_civitai_card_size.name: Card size
model_manager_civitai_card_size.heading: Civitai Browser Tab

model_manager_gallery_hide_nsfw.label: Hide explicit images when a gallery opens
model_manager_gallery_hide_nsfw.info: Whether explicit images are hidden when a gallery of Civitai's images opens: a model's gallery in the Model Manager or the Civitai Browser, and the Civitai Images tab. A model's Your generations follows it too; the Generations tab has its own setting. The Show NSFW switch above the images shows them in that gallery. The Civitai Browser's Include NSFW models is separate: it decides which models are listed, not which of their images are shown.
model_manager_gallery_hide_nsfw.name: Hide explicit images by default
model_manager_gallery_hide_nsfw.heading: Shared across tabs

model_manager_nsfw_detection.label: How to catch explicit images rated PG
model_manager_nsfw_detection.info: Civitai rates some explicit images PG or PG-13. This chooses how the extension finds them. The trained model reads each image's prompts and the resources it used, and catches most of them, but it judges by what it has learned: now and then it flags an image that is fine, or misses one that is not. The word list treats an image as X only when its prompt uses one of the listed words, so every decision can be checked. When this changes, your stored images are judged again in the background.
model_manager_nsfw_detection.name: How to catch explicit images rated PG
model_manager_nsfw_detection.heading: Shared across tabs

model_manager_nsfw_prompt_model_percent.label: PG images the model may flag, in %
model_manager_nsfw_prompt_model_percent.info: How readily the trained model flags images. The number is the percentage of PG and PG-13 images the model may treat as X, measured on the images it was trained on. A higher number catches more explicit images, and wrongly hides more that are fine; a lower one hides fewer, and misses more. At 2, the default, it caught about 94 in 100 X and XXX prompts in a library it had never seen, and flagged 2.2% of that library's PG and PG-13 images. 0 turns the model off, and only the word list is used. When this changes, your stored images are judged again in the background.
model_manager_nsfw_prompt_model_percent.name: PG images the model may flag, in %
model_manager_nsfw_prompt_model_percent.heading: Shared across tabs

model_manager_nsfw_prompt_words.label: Additional words to detect NSFW prompts
model_manager_nsfw_prompt_words.info: Words that mark a prompt as explicit, separated by commas. An image Civitai rates PG or PG-13 whose prompt uses one of them is treated as X everywhere: hidden from grid previews, galleries and the SFW filters. Words match whole, in any case. They add to the list that comes with the extension, in model_manager/data/nsfw_prompt_words.txt. When this changes, your stored images are judged again in the background.
model_manager_nsfw_prompt_words.name: Additional words to detect NSFW prompts
model_manager_nsfw_prompt_words.heading: Shared across tabs

model_manager_hide_promptless_images.label: Hide images with no prompt when a gallery opens
model_manager_hide_promptless_images.info: Whether images with no prompt are hidden when a model's gallery opens, in the Model Manager and the Civitai Browser. About a tenth of Civitai's images carry no prompt at all, so they cannot be read or made again. You can show them for one model with the switch above its images. The Civitai Images tab always shows every image.
model_manager_hide_promptless_images.name: Hide images with no prompt by default
model_manager_hide_promptless_images.heading: Shared across tabs

model_manager_generations_hide_nsfw.label: Hide explicit images when the Generations Tab opens
model_manager_generations_hide_nsfw.info: Whether explicit images are hidden when the Generations tab opens. The Show NSFW switch above the images shows them until the tab is opened again. A model's Your generations, in the Model Manager, follows the other Hide explicit images by default, under Shared across tabs.
model_manager_generations_hide_nsfw.name: Hide explicit images by default
model_manager_generations_hide_nsfw.heading: Generations Tab

model_manager_civitai_min_prompt_images.label: Images with a prompt a model needs to count as usable
model_manager_civitai_min_prompt_images.info: Used by the Civitai Browser's Only with usable prompts filter. A model is listed only if at least this many of its first 20 images have a usable prompt: a prompt with its steps, sampler and CFG scale.
model_manager_civitai_min_prompt_images.name: How many images with a prompt a model needs to count as usable
model_manager_civitai_min_prompt_images.heading: Civitai Browser Tab

model_manager_civitai_sfw_fill_page.label: Fill each page with models when hiding NSFW models
model_manager_civitai_sfw_fill_page.info: Used when Only Show Models with SFW images is ticked in the Civitai Browser. Normally a page stops after checking a few dozen models, and can come back with fewer than a full page. When this is on, it keeps searching until the page is full. Most Civitai models have NSFW images, so one page can take hundreds of requests and several minutes, and Civitai is likely to start turning requests away. A page still stops when Civitai does.
model_manager_civitai_sfw_fill_page.name: Fill each page with models when hiding NSFW models
model_manager_civitai_sfw_fill_page.heading: Civitai Browser Tab

model_manager_civitai_on_site_marks.label: Mark versions Civitai allows only on its site
model_manager_civitai_on_site_marks.info: Some creators allow a version only for generating on Civitai's site, and Civitai refuses to download it. When this is on, the Civitai Browser marks those versions on its cards and in a model's panel. To know them, it asks Civitai once per page and once per model you open; the answer is often under a megabyte, sometimes a few. The Model Manager marks them whatever this says, from what a sync stored.
model_manager_civitai_on_site_marks.name: Mark on-site-only versions
model_manager_civitai_on_site_marks.heading: Civitai Browser Tab

model_manager_send_clip_skip.label: Send uses the image's Clip skip
model_manager_send_clip_skip.info: When on, and an image was made with a clip skip other than your Clip Skip setting, Send adds the image's value to the tab's Override settings and says so, so the image can be made again as it was. It applies to the images you generate while it is there; your own setting does not change, and the next Send replaces it. Flux images are left alone, because clip skip changes nothing there. When off, clip skip is left to Forge's own paste, which Forge Neo ignores.
model_manager_send_clip_skip.name: Use the image's Clip skip
model_manager_send_clip_skip.heading: Shared across tabs

model_manager_send_clip_skip_max.label: Highest Clip skip Send takes from an image
model_manager_send_clip_skip_max.info: When an image's clip skip is above this number, Send leaves it out of Override settings, your own Clip Skip applies, and Send's notice says so. Most models are made for 1 or 2.
model_manager_send_clip_skip_max.name: Highest Clip skip
model_manager_send_clip_skip_max.heading: Shared across tabs

model_manager_modules_flux.label: Text encoders and VAE Send picks for Flux.1 / Chroma
model_manager_modules_flux.info: Flux.1 and Flux.1 Schnell need CLIP-L, T5-XXL and Flux VAE (ae); Chroma needs T5-XXL and Flux VAE (ae). Download: clip_l, t5xxl fp16, t5xxl fp8, ae
model_manager_modules_flux.name: Flux.1 / Chroma text encoders and VAE
model_manager_modules_flux.heading: Shared across tabs

model_manager_modules_klein.label: Text encoders and VAE Send picks for Flux.2 Klein
model_manager_modules_klein.info: Klein 4B needs Qwen3 4B and Flux.2 VAE; Klein 9B needs Qwen3 8B and Flux.2 VAE. Download: qwen_3_4b, qwen3_4b fp8, flux2-vae, qwen_3_8b, qwen_3_8b fp8
model_manager_modules_klein.name: Flux.2 Klein text encoders and VAE
model_manager_modules_klein.heading: Shared across tabs

model_manager_modules_lumina.label: Text encoders and VAE Send picks for Lumina Image 2.0
model_manager_modules_lumina.info: Needs Gemma 2 2B and Flux VAE (ae). Download: gemma_2_2b, ae
model_manager_modules_lumina.name: Lumina Image 2.0 text encoders and VAE
model_manager_modules_lumina.heading: Shared across tabs

model_manager_modules_zit.label: Text encoders and VAE Send picks for Z-Image
model_manager_modules_zit.info: Needs Qwen3 4B and Flux VAE (ae). Download: qwen_3_4b, qwen3_4b fp8, ae
model_manager_modules_zit.name: Z-Image text encoders and VAE
model_manager_modules_zit.heading: Shared across tabs

model_manager_modules_anima.label: Text encoders and VAE Send picks for Anima
model_manager_modules_anima.info: Needs Qwen3 0.6B and Qwen-Image VAE. Download: qwen_3_06b_base, qwen_image_vae
model_manager_modules_anima.name: Anima text encoders and VAE
model_manager_modules_anima.heading: Shared across tabs

model_manager_modules_wan.label: Text encoders and VAE Send picks for Wan
model_manager_modules_wan.info: Needs UMT5-XXL and Wan 2.1 VAE. UMT5-XXL loads only in the Hugging Face layout these links have. Download: umt5_xxl fp16, umt5_xxl fp8, wan_2.1_vae
model_manager_modules_wan.name: Wan text encoders and VAE
model_manager_modules_wan.heading: Shared across tabs

model_manager_modules_qwen.label: Text encoders and VAE Send picks for Qwen-Image
model_manager_modules_qwen.info: Needs Qwen2.5-VL 7B and Qwen-Image VAE. Download: qwen_2.5_vl_7b fp16, qwen_2.5_vl_7b fp8, qwen_image_vae
model_manager_modules_qwen.name: Qwen-Image text encoders and VAE
model_manager_modules_qwen.heading: Shared across tabs

model_manager_modules_krea.label: Text encoders and VAE Send picks for Krea 2
model_manager_modules_krea.info: Needs Qwen3-VL 4B and Qwen-Image VAE. Download: qwen3vl_4b bf16, qwen3vl_4b fp8, qwen_image_vae
model_manager_modules_krea.name: Krea 2 text encoders and VAE
model_manager_modules_krea.heading: Shared across tabs

model_manager_modules_ernie.label: Text encoders and VAE Send picks for ERNIE-Image
model_manager_modules_ernie.info: Needs Ministral 3 3B and Flux.2 VAE. Download: ministral-3-3b, flux2-vae
model_manager_modules_ernie.name: ERNIE-Image text encoders and VAE
model_manager_modules_ernie.heading: Shared across tabs

model_manager_modules_pid.label: Text encoders and VAE Send picks for PiD
model_manager_modules_pid.info: Needs Gemma 2 2B IT. Its VAE depends on the model, and is left to you. Download: gemma_2_2b_it bf16, gemma_2_2b_it fp8
model_manager_modules_pid.name: PiD text encoders and VAE
model_manager_modules_pid.heading: Shared across tabs

model_manager_generations_delete_files.label: Delete files by default when deleting generations
model_manager_generations_delete_files.info: Whether the box "also delete the image files" starts ticked when you delete generations. You can still untick it for one delete.
model_manager_generations_delete_files.name: Delete files by default when deleting generations
model_manager_generations_delete_files.heading: Shared across tabs

model_manager_generations_keep_inputs.label: Keep img2img source images and masks
model_manager_generations_keep_inputs.info: When on, each img2img generation that is recorded also keeps the picture it started from, and what you painted over it: the mask, or the strokes. Send can then put them back in img2img, and the image viewer shows them. Each picture is kept once, however many generations started from it, and deleted with the last of them. When off, nothing more is kept; what was kept before stays.
model_manager_generations_keep_inputs.name: Keep img2img source images and masks
model_manager_generations_keep_inputs.heading: Generations Tab

model_manager_image_sync_level.label: NSFW level Sync images gives images without infotext
model_manager_image_sync_level.info: The level the Sync images dialog has picked when it opens; the dialog saves the level you pick there for next time. Sync images gives that level to each image it adds that has no infotext, so the image is hidden or shown like any other at that level. A rating you give an image later always wins.
model_manager_image_sync_level.name: NSFW level for images without infotext
model_manager_image_sync_level.heading: Generations Tab

model_manager_group_no_text.label: Sync images groups images without infotext by file name
model_manager_group_no_text.info: Whether the Sync images dialog starts with this ticked; the dialog saves your choice for next time. When ticked, images without infotext are put together into batches, as if one press of Generate made them, when they sit in the same folder, their file names show the same settings with running numbers in order, and they were saved close together in time.
model_manager_group_no_text.name: Group images without infotext by name
model_manager_group_no_text.heading: Generations Tab

model_manager_database_path.label: Database file, needs a restart
model_manager_database_path.info: The full path of the database file, with its name. Leave it empty to use the default file, in the extension's folder. Two WebUIs can share one database file.
model_manager_database_path.name: Database file
model_manager_database_path.heading: Shared across tabs

model_manager_thumbnails.label: Make thumbnails by default
model_manager_thumbnails.info: When on, a thumbnail is made for each image you generate, and the Sync images dialog starts with Make thumbnails ticked; a sync with it ticked makes one for every image that has none. Tiles then load a small copy, 450 pixels tall, instead of the full file. The image viewer still shows the full file, and an image without a thumbnail shows its full file.
model_manager_thumbnails.name: Make thumbnails by default
model_manager_thumbnails.heading: Shared across tabs

model_manager_thumbnails_place.label: Where thumbnails of your generations are kept
model_manager_thumbnails_place.info: In a folder keeps every thumbnail in the Thumbnail folder below. Beside each image keeps each one in a .thumbnails folder next to its image, which Sync images skips. A change applies to thumbnails made from then on; those made before keep working where they are.
model_manager_thumbnails_place.name: Where thumbnails are kept
model_manager_thumbnails_place.heading: Shared across tabs

model_manager_thumbnails_folder.label: Folder for thumbnails, when kept in one
model_manager_thumbnails_folder.info: The full path of the folder thumbnails are kept in. Leave it empty to use a folder named thumbnails beside the database file, which two WebUIs sharing the database share too. It is safe to delete: a sync makes the thumbnails again.
model_manager_thumbnails_folder.placeholder: Empty: a thumbnails folder beside the database
model_manager_thumbnails_folder.name: Thumbnail folder
model_manager_thumbnails_folder.heading: Shared across tabs

model_manager_thumbnail_threads.label: How many thumbnails generated in parallel
model_manager_thumbnail_threads.info: How many thumbnails are made at the same time. 0 uses as many as the machine has processors, because making a thumbnail is mostly processor work. Use a lower number for a hard disk or a network drive, or to keep the machine free while a sync makes them.
model_manager_thumbnail_threads.name: How many thumbnails generated in parallel
model_manager_thumbnail_threads.heading: Shared across tabs

model_manager_queue_inputs_dir.label: Folder for the images queued tasks need
model_manager_queue_inputs_dir.info: Where a queued task keeps the images it was given, such as an img2img source and mask or ControlNet's images, one folder per task, until the task is deleted. Leave it empty to use a folder named queue-inputs in the WebUI's folder, beside outputs. Tasks keep the full paths of their files, so a change applies only to tasks queued after it.
model_manager_queue_inputs_dir.name: Folder for queued tasks' images
model_manager_queue_inputs_dir.heading: Queue Tab

model_manager_generations_inputs_dir.label: Folder for img2img source images
model_manager_generations_inputs_dir.info: The full path of the folder where img2img source images and masks are kept. Leave it empty to use a folder named generation-inputs beside the database file, which two WebUIs sharing the database share too. Generations keep the full paths of their files, so a change applies only to generations recorded after it.
model_manager_generations_inputs_dir.placeholder: Empty: a generation-inputs folder beside the database
model_manager_generations_inputs_dir.name: Folder for img2img source images
model_manager_generations_inputs_dir.heading: Generations Tab

model_manager_queue_ask_above.label: Ask before generating more images than
model_manager_queue_ask_above.info: When you press Generate for more images than this number (batch count times batch size), you are asked first: generate them now, queue them to run later from the Queue tab, or cancel. The question has a "Don't ask again in this browser" box. 0 means Generate never asks. It asks only while the Queue tab is on.
model_manager_queue_ask_above.name: Ask before generating more images than
model_manager_queue_ask_above.heading: Queue Tab

model_manager_hash_threads.label: Files a sync hashes at once
model_manager_hash_threads.info: How many model files a sync hashes at the same time when it identifies them. Each file is read in full, so the drive usually sets the pace. For a hard disk or a network drive, use 1 or 2, as more makes it slower; for a SATA SSD, 2 to 4; for an NVMe drive, 4 to 8, or more on a processor with many cores. Lower it if a sync slows the machine down.
model_manager_hash_threads.name: Files hashed at once
model_manager_hash_threads.heading: Model Manager Tab

model_manager_sync_images_per_version.label: Number of images stored per version by default at sync
model_manager_sync_images_per_version.info: How many of each version's Civitai images a sync fetches and keeps, whether it runs from the sync dialog, a model's Sync button or a download. The dialog's "First N images" uses this number. Keeping fewer means less to judge and show: a model's NSFW level counts its worst stored image, and the Civitai Images tab shows stored images only.
model_manager_sync_images_per_version.name: Number of images stored per version by default at sync
model_manager_sync_images_per_version.heading: Shared across tabs

model_manager_check_updates.label: Check for a new version of the Model Manager
model_manager_check_updates.info: When on, the extension reads the version.json file in its GitHub repository after the WebUI starts and every 12 hours. It reads only the version number, and each tab's header says when a newer version is out. When off, GitHub is never asked.
model_manager_check_updates.name: Check for a new version
model_manager_check_updates.heading: Shared across tabs
